meta.title: HKDSE 发音听说打卡 · Day 1–7
meta.phonemeNote: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。Day1：12单元音；Day2：6爆破音与8双元音；Day3：9摩擦音；Day4：破擦+鼻音；Day5：近音/流音+四组组合；Day6/7：复习迁移。面授日待老师定。

days.title: Day 1 · 长短元音 + 音节 + 重音
days.focusZh: 5 个长元音 /iː ɑː ɔː uː ɜː/ 与 7 个短元音 /ɪ e æ ʌ ɒ ʊ ə/；划分音节；听辨并点出单词重音。纯听说，不考词性。

sections.titleZh: ① 五个长元音
sections.tipZh: 长元音肌肉更紧、口型更稳。跟读时注意把目标元音念清楚，不要发成短元音。

items.ex: She wants to achieve better results this term.
Please complete the online form before Friday.
Speaking English well is a real advantage.
They rent a small apartment near the station.
It is important to manage your time carefully.
His performance in the test was much better.
Daily practice can improve your listening skills.
She has a university interview next Monday.
We need more research on climate change.
Personally, I prefer studying in the library.

sections.titleZh: ② 七个短元音
sections.tipZh: 短元音更短、更松。/ə/ 是弱读中最常见的音，非重读音节里经常出现。

items.ex: Making a decision about your future is not easy.
After-school activities help students relax.
Reading can help you develop better ideas.
Protecting the environment is everyone's job.
Learning a new skill is always a challenge.
Regular practice makes speaking more natural.
Travel helps you understand different cultures.
The exam result will come out next week.
We discussed the traffic problem in class.
Background knowledge helps you follow the talk.
Many teenagers prefer football to other sports.
A positive outlook helps in difficult times.
Students often study together before exams.
Check the information on the school website.

sections.titleZh: ③ 长短元音对比（最小对立）
sections.tipZh: 左右对照听、跟读。先听示范，再自己录，最后并排回放比较。

pairs.note: 紧张的 /iː/ vs 放松的 /ɪ/
词义完全不同，元音差一点点就会听错
英式 /ɔː/ 与 /ɒ/ 要分开

sections.titleZh: ④ 划分音节
sections.tipZh: 每个音节通常有一个元音核。先听示范慢速，再按点开的音节跟读。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 听辨重音（点出重读音节）
sections.tipZh: 先听示范（可慢速），再点击你认为带主重音 ˈ 的那一截。做对后再录音跟读整词。

items.gloss: 礼物；现在的（名词/形容词）

sections.titleZh: ⑥ 句子跟读
sections.tipZh: 注意句中重读词与弱读（a/the/to/of 常发 /ə/）。先听示范，再录音对比。

items.en: I need to improve my performance before the next interview.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

items.en: Protecting the environment is an important challenge for everyone.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

items.en: She made a decision to study technology at university.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

items.en: Personally, I think culture and knowledge open more opportunities.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

sections.titleZh: ⑦ 绕口令（热身）
sections.tipZh: 先慢后快。重点练清晰度，不要只求速度。

items.en: She seeks cheap seats in the city centre each evening.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

items.en: Good cooks look for sugar and put pudding in a cookbook.
items.focusNote: Content-word peaks from model audio energy (WordBoundary).

sections.titleZh: ⑧ 短文朗读（B1）
sections.tipZh: 先通读理解，再听示范，最后整段录音。注意意群停顿与重音。
sections.text: Many Senior Two students feel pressure when they think about university and future careers. Some want to study technology, while others prefer education or the environment. Making a decision is never easy, but practice and research can help. Personally, I believe that if we improve our communication skills and keep a positive outlook, we will find more opportunities.
sections.focus: decision, university, technology, environment, improve, communication, opportunities, personally, outlook

sections.titleZh: ⑨ 弱读对比（/ə/）
sections.tipZh: 功能词在连贯说话里常变弱。对比「强调读」与「自然弱读」。

days.title: Day 2 · 清浊爆破音＋8个双元音
days.titleEn: Plosives and all eight traditional British diphthongs
days.focusZh: 同一天介绍 /p b t d k ɡ/ 与8个传统英式双元音；核心15–20分钟，拓展自选。不考词性。面授日待老师定。
days.noteZh: 基础词只用于辨音，主练词以B1常见学校/生活/职业语境为主，未逐词EVP认证。清音/p t k/在重读音节首通常有送气，/s/后常不送气；浊音/b d ɡ/不能只靠嗓音响不响判断。弱读取决于语境和强调，不是重音在后就自动变短。传统/ʊə/在现代英式可读/ɔː/，tourist等示范可能采用变体，不判为错误。示范尚未逐条人工听审。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词覆盖8个双元音（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 先听常速，观察IPA与音节点，再跟读一次；蓝色只标目标音，不表示双元音是长单元音。兼听词中爆破音。

items.gloss: 辩论；顺带听辅音 /b / t / d/
全球的；顺带听辅音 /ɡ / b/

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: cap/cab：/p b/；write/ride：/t d/；back/bag：/k ɡ/；late/let：/eɪ e/。基础词仅作辨音，不作为B1新词。每组听A/B，跟读一遍；可任选一组录音。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句听说＋录音对比（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 每句听一次再录一次；回听自己的WAV与示范音，检查爆破音、双元音及意群。实义词可突出，虚词是否弱读依语境而定；不承诺固定强弱音值。

items.en: We will debate the choice of a global career.
Decide about the trip and prepare your ideas.
The tourist asked about local transport.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：点重音＋4音节迁移（2–3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 先听，再点主重音；不考词性。technology是辅音迁移词，不是新增双元音。

items.gloss: 全球的；顺带听辅音 /ɡ / b/

items.ex: Technology changes how teenagers study.

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：情境朗读（3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 整段听读一次，录WAV并回听。不作自动发音评分。
sections.text: Our group will debate the choice of a school trip. We need to decide about transport and prepare a clear plan. A tourist can share ideas about local places. Everyone has a chance to speak.
sections.focus: debate, choice, decide, about, prepare, tourist, local

days.title: Day 3 · 摩擦音
days.focusZh: 同一天练 /f v θ ð s z ʃ ʒ h/。核心约15–20分钟。特别注意 /θ ð/ 与 /ʃ ʒ/，以及词尾 /s z/。不考词性。
days.noteZh: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。核心15–20分钟；选做另计。纯听说，不考词性。面授日待老师定。示范音为 en-GB-SoniaNeural 神经合成，未逐条人工听审。弱读取决于语境与强调，不是重音靠后前元音就自动变短。 /h/ 放在句子与选做中覆盖。think/they 等基础词仅用于辨音。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词听读（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 先听常速，看IPA与音节点，再跟读。绿色只标当日目标摩擦音。

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: 基础词仅作辨音。think/sink：/θ s/；they/day：/ð d/；ship/sip：/ʃ s/；fan/van：/f v/。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句听说＋录音对比（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 每句听一次、录一次，回听WAV并与示范对比。注意 /θ ð ʃ ʒ h/ 与意群；虚词弱读依语境，不保证固定音值。

items.en: I think further research will show the real effect.
Social media usually shapes teenage behaviour.
Travel and information help us understand the environment.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：点重音（2–3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 先听再点主重音。healthy 覆盖 /h/ 与 /θ/。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：情境朗读（3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 整段听读一次并录音回听。不作自动评分。
sections.text: Teenagers usually spend hours on social media. This can have a real effect on sleep and behaviour. I think we should search for better information and share things carefully. Further discussion at school can help students make wiser decisions.
sections.focus: usually, social, effect, behaviour, think, information, further, decisions

days.title: Day 4 · 破擦音 + 鼻音
days.focusZh: 同一天练 /tʃ dʒ m n ŋ/。重点听 /n/–/ŋ/ 与词尾 -ing。核心约15–20分钟。不考词性。
days.noteZh: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。核心15–20分钟；选做另计。纯听说，不考词性。面授日待老师定。示范音为 en-GB-SoniaNeural 神经合成，未逐条人工听审。弱读取决于语境与强调，不是重音靠后前元音就自动变短。 challenge/manager 等多音节B1词；thin/thing 等基础词仅辨音。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词听读（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 绿色标目标破擦/鼻音。/ŋ/ 只用舌后，词尾不要硬加 /ɡ/。

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: thin/thing、win/wing：/n ŋ/；cheap/jeep：/tʃ dʒ/；batch/badge：词尾清浊。基础词仅辨音。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句听说＋录音对比（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 注意 -ing 的 /ŋ/ 与 /tʃ dʒ/。录后并排回听。

items.en: Changing language habits is a real challenge.
Community projects need careful thinking.
Education and knowledge shape your future.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：点重音（2–3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 先听再点主重音。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：情境朗读（3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 整段听读并录音回听。
sections.text: Language learning is changing because of the internet. Students need knowledge and critical thinking. Joining a community project can be a challenge, but it helps you manage your future with more confidence.
sections.focus: language, changing, knowledge, thinking, community, challenge, manage, future

days.title: Day 5 · 近音 / 流音＋四组组合
days.focusZh: 同一天练 /l r w j/，并介绍四组常用组合 /tr dr ts dz/（补齐传统48教学项；它们不是四个独立基本音位）。核心约15–20分钟。
days.noteZh: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。核心15–20分钟；选做另计。纯听说，不考词性。面授日待老师定。示范音为 en-GB-SoniaNeural 神经合成，未逐条人工听审。弱读取决于语境与强调，不是重音靠后前元音就自动变短。 英式 /r/ 不宜过度卷舌；词尾 /l/ 可略偏暗。组合在核心句与选做中练习。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词听读（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 绿色标 /l r w j/。注意 light/right、west/vest 类对比放在下一节。

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: light/right、collect/correct：/l r/；west/vest：/w v/；year/ear：有无 /j/。基础词仅辨音。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句听说＋录音对比（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 句中顺带练 /tr dr ts dz/ 组合。录后并排回听。

items.en: I really want a reliable career after this year.
We should be aware of the wider world.
Traffic, drama clubs and sports attract hundreds of friends at weekends.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：四组组合词（2–3分钟）
sections.tipZh: /tr dr/ 为连缀；/ts dz/ 常见于词尾或复数。不是四个独立音位。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：情境朗读（3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 整段听读并录音回听。
sections.text: This year many teenagers review their lifestyle and career ideas. Stay aware, read reliable research, and really practise speaking a little every day. Local drama clubs and sports can also help.
sections.focus: year, lifestyle, career, aware, reliable, research, really, drama, sports

days.title: Day 6 · 合口双元音复习与迁移
days.focusZh: 复习 Day2 已介绍的 /eɪ aɪ ɔɪ aʊ əʊ/，迁移到学习计划与选择话题；不是首次介绍。核心约15–20分钟，可按薄弱点选练。
days.noteZh: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。核心15–20分钟；选做另计。纯听说，不考词性。面授日待老师定。示范音为 en-GB-SoniaNeural 神经合成，未逐条人工听审。弱读取决于语境与强调，不是重音靠后前元音就自动变短。 本课不教新音位。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词复习听读（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 蓝色标目标双元音。注意滑动完整，不要发成单元音。

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音复习（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: late/let：/eɪ e/；light/lot：开口对比；coat/caught：/əʊ ɔː/；now/nor：/aʊ ɔː/。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句复习录音（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 双元音滑动完整。录后回听对比。

items.en: Explain your choice and focus on a clear goal.
Decide about online learning for the local community.
Daily practice allows you to improve your speaking.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：点重音（2分钟）
sections.tipZh: 复习重音位置。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：情境朗读（3分钟）
sections.tipZh: 整段复习录音。
sections.text: Teenagers must decide about subject choice and future goals. Online tools allow daily practice, but you still need to explain your ideas clearly. Focus on local issues and make a choice you can stand by.
sections.focus: decide, choice, goals, online, allow, daily, explain, focus, local

days.title: Day 7 · 集中双元音复习＋七日综合
days.titleEn: Centring diphthong review and week wrap-up
days.focusZh: 复习 Day2 已介绍的 /ɪə eə ʊə/，并结合全周辅音、重音与自然语流做综合录音；不是首次介绍。/ʊə/ 现代英式可为 /ɔː/。
days.noteZh: 传统48教学项＝20元音＋24基本辅音＋tr/dr/ts/dz四组组合（并非48个独立音位）。核心15–20分钟；选做另计。纯听说，不考词性。面授日待老师定。示范音为 en-GB-SoniaNeural 神经合成，未逐条人工听审。弱读取决于语境与强调，不是重音靠后前元音就自动变短。 tourist/sure/poor 等可能听到 /ɔː/ 变体，不判为错误。本课不作固定强弱读公式承诺。

sections.titleZh: ① 核心：8词复习听读（5–6分钟）
sections.tipZh: 注意滑向 /ə/。/ʊə/ 可听成 /ɔː/。

sections.titleZh: ② 核心：4组辨音复习（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: beer/bee：/ɪə iː/；care/key：听滑动；tour/two：/ʊə uː/；sure/shore：现代 /ʊə/≈/ɔː/ 对照。

sections.titleZh: ③ 核心：3句综合录音（6–8分钟）
sections.tipZh: 把本周辅音与双元音串起来。不作固定弱读评分。

items.en: Prepare carefully for your career interview.
Make sure tourists respect the local area.
I really need an idea about my future path.

sections.titleZh: ④ 选做：综合重音（2分钟）
sections.tipZh: 点出主重音。

sections.titleZh: ⑤ 选做：七日综合短文（3–4分钟）
sections.tipZh: 本周总测：整段录音并并排对比示范。
sections.text: To prepare for a speaking test, be aware of clear sounds, word stress and natural rhythm. Listen carefully to model audio, then record your own ideas about careers, travel or the environment. Make sure you really practise every day. Experience grows when you review, improve and try again.
sections.focus: prepare, aware, carefully, careers, environment, sure, really, experience, review, improve
